The clinical workflow is complete. I've reviewed all available records for patient PAT-101:

- Device record shows a pump with amended settings
- Glucose record shows values at unequal intervals with a missing encounter reference
- Therapy note identifies a draft update with no signed parameter disposition

I created a parameter review to flag the unsigned draft parameter disposition for formal review and signature. The workspace can now be closed as the identified clinical issue has been addressed through the review process.
